verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance platform, so a self-updating trust center is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions a trust center, public subprocessor lists, or automated document renewals published to customers. Continuous monitors and dashboard control status are internal compliance features and only adjacent to a trust center that stays current on its own.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
